prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal vertical high-grain disposable-camera snapshot in a Tokyo-style subway stairwell. An adult woman descends the stairs mid-step, wearing a buttoned white short-sleeve blouse, navy wide-leg trousers, simple flat shoes, and a black shoulder bag. Her loose dark hair is swept by movement, one hand near the rail, and her alert expression remains partially sharp while the clothing and commuters blur naturally. Shoot from an upper landing with a tilted urgent composition. Use cold green-blue fluorescent tube lights, humid atmosphere, high film grain, chromatic aberration, lens distortion, uneven exposure, focus drift, and no readable station signs, advertisements, logos, or text.
